UI_RemoveLimits_SyncDescription: These controls mirror the current world's Infinite Capacity sandbox settings. In multiplayer, administrators can submit changes to the server; other players follow the server settings.
UI_RemoveLimits_CarryWeightSection: 1. Carry Weight — controls how much the character can carry without becoming overloaded. Character-inventory transfers follow the same limit.
UI_RemoveLimits_CharacterMode_Tooltip: Controls the character's real native maximum carry weight, Heavy Load status, displayed limit, and character-inventory transfer limit.
UI_RemoveLimits_CharacterCapacityLimit_T: Used when Carry weight mode is set to Custom limit. The character-inventory transfer limit follows this value.
UI_RemoveLimits_TransferWeightSection: 2. Transfer Weight — controls whether items can be moved into bags, world containers, and vehicle containers.
UI_RemoveLimits_ContainerMode_Tooltip: Keep vanilla transfer limits, multiply each container's original weight limit, or allow transfers without a weight limit.
UI_RemoveLimits_ContainerMultiplier_Tool: Used when Container transfer weight mode is set to Multiplier.
UI_RemoveLimits_AffectBags_Tooltip: Apply the selected transfer weight mode to carried and stored bags.
UI_RemoveLimits_AffectWorldContainers_To: Apply the selected transfer weight mode to cupboards, crates, furniture, corpses, and other world containers.
UI_RemoveLimits_AffectVehicles_Tooltip: Apply the selected transfer weight mode to trunks, glove boxes, seats, and bags stored in vehicles.
UI_RemoveLimits_VehicleSeatSection: 3. Vehicle Seats — independently controls whether items stored on a seat prevent entry.
UI_RemoveLimits_AllowSeatWithItems: Allow entering seats that contain items
UI_RemoveLimits_AllowSeatWithItems_Toolt: When enabled, a character may enter a seat even when it contains items; a passenger still occupies the seat. This setting works independently of transfer capacity and vehicle cargo mass settings.
UI_RemoveLimits_VehicleMassSection: 4. Vehicle Cargo Mass — independently controls whether stored cargo affects vehicle physics mass.
UI_RemoveLimits_IgnoreVehicleCargoMass: Vehicle cargo does not add mass
UI_RemoveLimits_IgnoreVehicleCargoMass_T: Items stored in vehicle containers do not increase vehicle physics mass. Installed parts still count.
